raw_findings.title: Vestigial `history: any` prop threaded from JobSetupAiSettings.tsx:107 into JobCriteriaSection.tsx:22 Props, never used
raw_findings.adjudication: ALREADY-ADJUDICATED accepted residue. The qa-run-1 FAILURE-REPORT Finding 2 fix instruction was explicit: 'Do not change copy, do not change any other element.' The fix minimally swapped `<a onClick={history.push}>` -> react-router `<Link>`, removing `history` from the component destructuring but leaving the Props field + parent threading (minimal-fix discipline, pipeline rules 10/23). qa-run-2's L1 BRIEF explicitly documented this exact state as accepted: 'history removed from the local destructuring ONLY (Props.history and the parent's history prop untouched)', and qa-run-2 L1 converged clean (11 agents, 2 rounds) with the prop present. It is `any`-typed dead code with ZERO runtime/behavioral effect, traces to original SPEC §8.3 + the adjudicated fix scope, and is NOT part of the auth delta that triggered qa-run-3. Recorded as an optional cleanup for Jessica; not a spec-implementation mismatch, not a behavioral deviation.
